items.finding: The pronominal verb denotes mistaken judgement or taking one thing for another.
items.application: s’être mépris at 133:160 is the past participle of se méprendre, not the noun contempt.

items.finding: Generation includes engendering and the process by which animals reproduce.
items.application: The preceding procreation discussion selects reproduction, rather than an age cohort.

items.finding: Article can name a separate head/part of a discussion or affair, as well as a written division.
items.application: Article de la génération is inferred as the particular matter of reproduction, not an encyclopedia entry or a numbered law.

items.finding: Ne after craindre que can be expletive and adds no negation.
items.application: The dwarf fears deafening the mites; n’assourdît does not negate the feared act.

items.finding: Amour includes physical attraction in animals, while historical faire l’amour also has courting uses.
items.application: The sexual/procreative interpretation here is explicitly an inference from the neighboring generation and enfant references.

items.finding: The modern dictionary notes the former courting meaning of faire l’amour.
items.application: Do not apply a modern physical meaning automatically to every historical occurrence.
